tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page and map ground. Daylight is the zine paper; Depth is depth-black from the colour ladder.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Map canvas under tiles, freshness strip, inline code ground, hover on icon channels.

tokens.name: drawer-bg
tokens.usage: Drawers, topbar brand, chips and buttons at rest.

tokens.name: status-bg
tokens.usage: The thin status bar at the top of a space profile.

tokens.name: surface-white
tokens.usage: Drawer heads, space hero, hovered result rows, kbd. The map's literal #fff, named.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on paper, drawer-bg and surface-white (15.6:1 daylight, 15.8:1 depth). Also the fill of pressed chips and primary buttons.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Section labels and contact glyphs on drawer-bg.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, meta lines, mono labels on paper and drawer-bg (5.3:1 daylight, 5.1:1 depth).

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Empty-field placeholders and the seeded dashed outline. Decorative only: 1.8:1 on paper, never use for text that must be read.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Every 1.5px border and dashed divider. In Depth it is depth-border and reads as structure, not as a hard line.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Riso red. Focus ring, hover fill of primary actions, broken state, the 'next' unlock marker. 3.6:1 on paper: fine for the 2.5px focus ring and 1.5px borders, below 4.5:1 for small text (source pair kept, flagged). Depth value is genjson's lifted red.

tokens.name: accent-2
tokens.usage: Cobalt. Links, inline choices, search focus, confirmed badge text. 4.3:1 on paper: passes for 14px+ bold, slightly under 4.5:1 for 9.5–10px labels (flagged). Depth value is genjson's lifted cobalt.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Riso red deep enough to read as text: errors and broken in running text (5.9:1 on paper, 6.1:1 on drawer-bg). Added 2026-10-24 for the kit skin, where accent (3.6:1) cannot carry an error message. Depth keeps accent's lifted red.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Chrome-level 'alive' signal: freshness dot, open badge, done unlock marker, bot dot. 3.3:1 on paper; pair it with a word, never alone. Not a decorative accent.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Aging dot in the freshness strip and the base of the yellow note. Never text.

tokens.name: aging-text
tokens.usage: Text of the aging status label, on its #fff8d6 wash (3.4:1 on paper — flagged).

tokens.name: aging-wash
tokens.usage: Background of the aging status label.

tokens.name: dead-wash
tokens.usage: Background of the dead status label; its text is #444444.

tokens.name: dead-text
tokens.usage: Text and border of the dead status label, on dead-wash.

tokens.name: state-seeded
tokens.usage: PROTECTED. Seeded pin fill: scraped, unclaimed. Smallest, dimmest point on the map.

tokens.name: state-confirmed
tokens.usage: Confirmed pin fill: live endpoint, attested. Same in both surfaces.

tokens.name: state-shut
tokens.usage: PROTECTED. Live but closed right now. Resting green — never black.

tokens.name: state-open
tokens.usage: PROTECTED. Live and open this minute: the brightest, largest mark, with the pulse halo.

tokens.name: state-aging
tokens.usage: PROTECTED. Lifecycle 30–90 days without a content change. Dashed outline, no offset shadow.

tokens.name: state-zombie
tokens.usage: PROTECTED. 90–180 days. Dashed, transparent fill, 60% opacity.

tokens.name: state-dead
tokens.usage: PROTECTED. 180+ days. Off the ladder: the grey tombstone, never 'darker blue'.

tokens.name: state-broken
tokens.usage: PROTECTED. Endpoint erroring for 60+ minutes. Red with a white ×; recoverable, alarm is alarm in both surfaces.

tokens.name: state-stroke
tokens.usage: Default pin outline on the GL layer.

tokens.name: state-stroke-seeded
tokens.usage: Seeded pin outline on the GL layer.

tokens.name: state-stroke-dead
tokens.usage: Dead pin outline on the GL layer.

tokens.name: state-stroke-zombie
tokens.usage: Zombie pin outline on the GL layer.

tokens.name: glow-near
tokens.usage: Continental glow halo at zoom 6 (interpolates to glow-far by zoom 9).

tokens.name: glow-far
tokens.usage: Continental glow halo at zoom 9.

tokens.name: uv
tokens.usage: Depth only: the UV-cyan core of an open-now pin. Never a UI accent.
